commit.message:
invoices: require complete payment collection

In this commit, we distinguish failed released HTLCs from attempts
canceled before preimage release. Once every released HTLC has a final
outcome, an ordinary invoice is settled only if all were collected.
Otherwise we cancel it while retaining the amount actually received.
Persisting the failed state keeps this decision independent of outcome
order and restart.

Expose failed collection and the release decision through RPC. Preserve
the first settlement index when later duplicates finish. Backend,
recovery, replay and RPC regressions cover the persisted outcome
contract. AMP settlement is unchanged.

Signed-off-by: Olaoluwa Osuntokun <laolu32@gmail.com>

commit.message:
itest: preserve MPP siblings across restart

Send ordinary MPP shards alongside a fresh child of a settled AMP set
using real onions and the persistent replay log. Require normal HTLC
rejection for the closed set while the ordinary invoice is accepted.

Release the ordinary hold preimage with its payer offline, restart the
receiver, and verify reconnection establishes final invoice credit and
the expected channel balances. Reuse existing stream and restart helpers
without adding goroutines or production hooks.

commit.message:
multi: defer ordinary invoice settlement

Release ordinary, MPP and hold preimages into PENDING_SETTLE, then
assign final credit and the settlement index through recorded HTLC
outcomes. Recover pending children beneath terminal parents without
allocating another index; let recorded failures override channel
inference and retry channel-only completion while running.

Switch ordinary replay, preimage lookup, expiry, notifications and RPC
projection together. Preserve the parent’s AMP settlement mechanisms and
controls; AMP finality remains deferred. Reuse existing integration
invoice waits rather than adding another harness API.

Cover partial credit, all-failed cancellation, recovery races, transient
writes and pending RPC timestamps using the existing backend fixtures.

commit.message:
htlcswitch: persist replay state before settle

Defer exit-hop callbacks until the existing forwarding-package marker is
durable. A restart can then recover a released preimage through the
processed-package path rather than fail its onion as a replay.

Keep callbacks synchronous and ordered before forwarding packets. Test a
real incoming commitment with a failed marker write: its invoice stays
open and no fulfill reaches the peer. The successful control uses the
real marker store.

commit.message:
invoices: supply final HTLC outcomes

Read recorded and channel-state outcomes through chanstate types. Inject
the existing final-outcome subscription so the invoice source lives
beside its consumer without importing concrete providers.

Require trustworthy snapshots for inference. Restored or data-loss
channels need recorded outcomes, including after closure. Read archived
status for closed candidates and leave outcomes unknown on read failure.
Abandoned incoming HTLCs still on a commitment remain pending.

An absent incoming HTLC only proves collection when its index precedes
the snapshot's next remote HTLC index. Leave unseen contracts pending on
both open and archived channels while retaining recorded outcomes.

Persist local data loss before dispatching an unknown tweakless remote
close, so archival retains the lost-state evidence. Abort on a failed
write and preserve legacy point-driven reestablishment ordering.

Cover these evidence boundaries alongside normal channel controls,
including recovery without reestablishment and failed status
persistence.

Remote-force-close inference additionally requires the remote commitment
to have seen the incoming HTLC, since its view can lag the local one.
Preserve pending outcomes when that payment evidence is missing.

commit.message:
invoices: reconcile ordinary HTLC outcomes

Track released ordinary circuits until their final outcomes can be
written through the invoice transaction. Retry missed events and writes
using the existing finalizer lifecycle and periodic reconciliation.

Re-read durable outcomes after channel inference so a concurrent
recorded failure wins over inferred success. Infer unresolved
channel-only outcomes after successful startup too, without an extra
worker or flag.

Keep only ordinary payment hashes in the pending map and use mock.Mock
for the controlled source fixture. AMP finality remains deferred.
